hero.title: Aitogogoŋ Angor, Aijulak Teso.
hero.subtitle: Teso Women Empowerment Youth Organization Initiative (TEWOYEI) erai eicolong loangor loete keda akitogogoŋ keda aijulakin Teso.

about.title: Kouye keda akitogogoŋ
about.content: Ageun kotoma okaru 2018, TEWOYEI ageun kwape egiriko loangor lueitingerete aibwo keda akitogogoŋ. Aboikin isio ebe atiokisio nueloliete angor—kwape akitameun aidis, akitagalakin keda ailatit.
about.pillars: Apilae nuepolok: Aiyun, Adup keda Aitidau.
